reviewNotes: Twenty-five Sam, Vincent, Maru, Sebastian, and Seed Shop map strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover music, computing, laboratory, school-report, family-book, game-title, and pet context, line-break controls, grades, and natural Romanian; both found no remaining objective issue.

SamHouse.7.source: There's a bunch of skateboarding magazines.
SamHouse.7.translation: Este un teanc de reviste despre skateboarding.

SamHouse.9.source: Sam's electric guitar. It has a pair of active pickups and a whammy bar.
SamHouse.9.translation: Chitara electrică a lui Sam. Are o pereche de doze active și o manetă de tremolo.

SamHouse.11.source: It's Sam's computer. He's got an extensive library of computer games.
SamHouse.11.translation: Este computerul lui Sam. Are o bibliotecă impresionantă de jocuri pe calculator.

SamHouse.12.source: Vincent's toys are strewn about the room.
SamHouse.12.translation: Jucăriile lui Vincent sunt împrăștiate prin cameră.

ScienceHouse.2.source: For a gadgeteer, Maru's computer is pretty old. She's still backing up her files to floppy disk.
ScienceHouse.2.translation: Pentru o inventatoare de dispozitive, computerul lui Maru este destul de vechi. Încă își face copii de siguranță ale fișierelor pe dischete.

ScienceHouse.4.source: There's a bunch of carpentry magazines.
ScienceHouse.4.translation: Este un teanc de reviste despre tâmplărie.

ScienceHouse.7.source: It's some kind of device Maru's working on. It looks pretty scrappy.
ScienceHouse.7.translation: Este un fel de dispozitiv la care lucrează Maru. Pare destul de improvizat.
